title: 2.3 Things
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Name everyday things with un or una: libro, pluma, teléfono, mochila, bolsa, silla, mesa.
grammar_function: Es un/una + thing; Es un X, no un/una Y.

cards.pedagogy_note: A handbag or tote is eine Tasche; a backpack is ein Rucksack.
